auth.confirmationSent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. It can take a few minutes to arrive — check your spam and Promotions folders if you don't see it. Follow the link to finish creating your account, then come back and log in.
auth.consentBefore: By signing up you agree to our
auth.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
auth.emailTypo: Did you mean {{suggestion}}? Tap to use it.
auth.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a link to reset your password.
auth.resetPasswordIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
auth.usernameHint: This is the name shown next to your reviews and the places you add. You can change it later.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language LocaStar uses. Following the system means it changes when your phone does.

notifications.deleteAllBody: This can’t be undone. Anything they point to — friend requests, shared lists, places — stays where it is.
notifications.roleGrantedBody1: Thank you for everything you’ve contributed to LocaStar. You can now handle reports, hide or remove content that breaks the rules, and propose bans.
notifications.roleGrantedBody2: With great power comes great responsibility — every action you take is recorded in the moderation log, so use it thoughtfully and fairly.
notifications.friendRequestBody: Tap to accept or decline it on your Friends page.
notifications.friendAcceptedBody: You can now share places and lists with each other.
notifications.reminderBody: You saved this. Tap to see the details.

add.title: Add to the map
add.intro: LocaStar is only as good as what people put in it. If you know somewhere worth going, add it — the next person looking will be glad you did.
add.signedOut: You need an account to add to the map.
add.placeBody: A court, a trail, a gym, a swimming spot — somewhere that is always there.
add.activityBody: A festival, a match, a meet-up — something happening on a date.

profile.title: Profile
profile.loggedOutPrompt: Log in to save favorites, write reviews, and add your own locations.
profile.logOutConfirmBody: You’ll need to log in again to access your account.
profile.banUntil: Until {{date}}, you can browse but not post reviews, add locations, or share.
profile.banIndefinite: You can browse but not post reviews, add locations, or share.

home.ctaTitle: Create an account and do more:

location.deletePhotoBody: It is removed from this place for everyone, and the deletion is recorded in the moderation log. This cannot be undone.
location.makeCoverBody: This picture will lead the gallery and appear on this place wherever it is listed.
location.deleteReviewBody: Your rating and any photos on it go too, and the place’s average is recalculated. This can’t be undone.
location.removeReviewBody: It stops being visible to everyone immediately, and the removal is recorded in the moderation log. It can be restored from there.
location.removeCreatorBody: Your username will no longer show as “Added by” on this listing. This can’t be undone.
location.reportLocationConfirm: Our team will review this location.
location.reportReviewConfirm: Our team will review this review.
location.creatorWindow: You added this — you can edit it for {{time}} more.
location.deleteLocationBody: This permanently deletes “{{name}}” and everything tied to it — reviews, photos, saves, and shares, including anything the people you invited added. This can’t be undone.

form.nameRequired: A name is required — this is what people see and search for.
form.dragPin: Drag the pin if it is in the wrong spot.
form.emailInvalid: That doesn’t look like an email address. Leave it empty if you’d rather not give one.

addLocation.disclaimerPlace: Locations go live as soon as you submit them, and are moderated afterwards. Anyone can report a location that is misleading, unlawful, or in the wrong place, and reported locations are reviewed and can be hidden or removed. Adding locations in violation of the rules will result in a warning — repeated invalid submissions will get your account blocked from creating new locations.
addLocation.disclaimerActivity: Any activity that is unlawful or not created by its rightful owner will result in a block on creating future activities. All activities must follow the rules — violations may result in a ban and could lead to legal action from the rightful owner.
addLocation.alreadyHereBody: If one of these is the same place, open it and add a review instead — that keeps all the ratings and photos together.
addLocation.geocodeFailed: We couldn’t find that address on the map, so the pin hasn’t moved. Check the spelling, or drag the pin to the right spot yourself — the pin is what decides where this place actually is.

areYouOwner.place: *Are you the owner of the place?
areYouOwner.activity: *Are you the owner of the activity?

addLocation.publicOrPrivate: *Should this activity be public or private? Private is only visible to people you share it with (e.g. a party or wedding).
addLocation.publishDateHint: Leave the publish date blank to make this activity visible as soon as it’s approved — or pick a later date to schedule when it should go live.
addLocation.visibleAsCreator: *Do you want to be visible as the creator?
addLocation.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
addLocation.tooLong: Activities can only run for up to {{days}} days — choose an earlier end date.
addLocation.publishAfterEnd: The publish date can’t be after the end date.

liveNow.place: Your place is live now. Moderation happens afterwards — it can be hidden or removed if it turns out to break the rules.
liveNow.activity: Your activity is live now. Moderation happens afterwards — it can be hidden or removed if it turns out to break the rules.

scheduled.place: Your place is saved and will go live on {{date}}. Moderation happens afterwards — it can be hidden or removed if it turns out to break the rules.
scheduled.activity: Your activity is saved and will go live on {{date}}. Moderation happens afterwards — it can be hidden or removed if it turns out to break the rules.

claimFailed.place: Your place was saved, but we couldn’t register your ownership claim. Open the place and use “Claim this business” to try again.
claimFailed.activity: Your activity was saved, but we couldn’t register your ownership claim. Open the activity and use “Claim this business” to try again.

discardWarning.place: Your place hasn’t been submitted yet. Everything you’ve filled in will be lost.
discardWarning.activity: Your activity hasn’t been submitted yet. Everything you’ve filled in will be lost.

photoRetry.place: Your place was saved, but its photos didn’t finish uploading. Tap submit again to retry — that won’t create a second place.
photoRetry.activity: Your activity was saved, but its photos didn’t finish uploading. Tap submit again to retry — that won’t create a second activity.

submitError.place: Something went wrong submitting your place. Try again.
submitError.activity: Something went wrong submitting your activity. Try again.

tapDragPin.place: Tap or drag the pin to set exactly where this place is.
tapDragPin.activity: Tap or drag the pin to set exactly where this activity is.

editLocation.saveError: Something went wrong saving your changes. Try again.
editLocation.windowExpired: The 24 hours you had to correct this have passed, so changes can no longer be saved. Report the location or contact support if something on it is wrong.
editLocation.geocodeFailed: We couldn’t find that address on the map, so the pin hasn’t moved. Drag it to the right spot instead — the pin is what decides where this place is.
editLocation.uploadSignedOut: Signed out before the photos could be uploaded.

settings.notifRemindersDesc: The day before an activity you saved starts
settings.notifReviewsDesc: Replies and likes on your reviews
settings.notifSharesDesc: When someone shares a place with you
settings.accountReauth: Enter your current password to change your email.
settings.currentPasswordHint: Required to change the email on your account.
settings.emailChangeHint: You’ll need to confirm from both your old and new inbox, and after that you log in with the new address. Only use an address you control.
settings.passwordIntro: Confirm your current password, then choose a new one.
settings.unblockBody: {{name}} will be able to send you friend requests and share locations and lists with you again.
settings.noBlocked: You haven’t blocked anyone. You can block someone from a friend request, or from their profile.
settings.blockedHint: Blocked people can’t send you friend requests or share locations and lists with you. They aren’t told they’ve been blocked.
settings.noPhotoYet: You haven’t added a photo yet.
settings.deleteAccountConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your profile, favorites, lists and friends. Reviews, photos and places you added stay in the app with your name removed. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccountError: Something went wrong deleting your account. Try again.
settings.deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your profile, username, profile picture, favorites, bucket list, shared locations, lists and friends. There is no way to undo this.
settings.deleteAccountEmailNote: We’ll send a confirmation to your email address so you know it happened — and so you can tell us if it wasn’t you.
settings.removePhotoBody: Your photo is deleted and you’ll show up with the default picture instead. You can add a new one any time.
settings.photoUploadError: Something went wrong uploading your photo. Try again.
settings.photoRemoveError: Something went wrong removing your photo. Try again.
